Head of AI, Example Manufacturing Ltd.

Responsibilities:
Own the enterprise AI strategy and define AI standards and policies for all business units.
Set up an AI center of excellence that coordinates AI projects across divisions.
Establish an AI governance framework, including a review board for high-risk use cases.

Requirements:
10+ years in data science or machine learning, including deployment of ML models.
Strong business acumen in industrial manufacturing.

We offer a competitive salary and hybrid work.

Chief Information Officer, Example Services Inc.

Responsibilities:
Lead the IT organization, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Manage the ERP roadmap and vendor contracts.

Requirements:
Experience as IT executive in a regulated industry.

Apply via our careers page.

AI Manager, Example Retail Group

AI Governance

Knowledge of Python and cloud AI platforms.
